notes.title: ♦️ New Demo Update!
notes.content:
[p]🎪 Hello! We’ve been working on some additions recently, and we decided to update the demo version with some of them.
[/p][p][b]Unfortunately, since translations are still being developed and implemented, they will NOT be included in this update.[/b]
[/p][h3][b]Additions:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]New gate mechanic[/p][/*][*][p]New trap mechanic[/p][/*][*][p]Updated 3D model and textures of the house[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Changes:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Relocation of some traps[/p][/*][*][p]Small changes to the environment[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][b]New Gate Mechanic[/b][/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558534/bb402f81bcd5939b8ea238ee540b80d2c463ccda.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]New Trap Mechanic[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558534/0acb4151091b5b8acdf711e8e80079be20cf53b7.gif"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content:
[p]Hello, this is a small update based on feedback and analysis of gameplays from several different sources.

If you have any feedbacks, please, feel free to share with us. Thank you. 🎪[/p][p][/p][h3][b]🔴 Changes:[/b]  [/h3][list][*][p]Decreased amount of Batteries in the scenario.  [/p][/*][*][p]Decrease in the amount of Sneakers in the scenario.  [/p][/*][*][p]Slight decrease in the amount of stamina received by Sneakers.  [/p][/*][*][p]Removal of some gates.    [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]🔴 Corrections:[/b]  [/h3][list][*][p]The flashlight sprite in the HUD now moves when “headbob” is disabled in the options.    [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]🔴 Additions:[/b]  [/h3][list][*][p][b]Hall access after the completion of the stage.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Addition of an objective progress bar in the HUD.[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558534/ea13db2e0a7e90603b614d0dd759f57e4f137caf.gif"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Demo Available on 05/09/2025
notes.content:
🔴 Hello, magnanimous audience!

We happily announce that the demo of The Mare Show will be released on [b]09/05/2025![/b] 

But after all, [b]what can we expect from this demo?[/b]
[list]
[*] Impressive atmosphere 
[*] Frenetic chase
[*] A bloodthirsty scarecrow
[/list]
[b]Get ready for fun, it's just the beginning of a great show to come.
[/b]
See you soon!
